reviews.comment: She did a decent professor

She made her lecture very boring and it always felt like she didn't want to be there, very much at A&M for research. Be ready to learn the entire course on your own but you still have to go to lecture for attendance. The quizzes were hard she doesn't really prepare you. Hire an outside tutor to pass! Take another prof if you wanna pass the class.
Very rude and tough to work with. Skips material in lectures and wont answer questions in class.

She speeds through the lectures and doesn't fully explain the topics. She does iClicker during class so you have to go to every lecture. Her reviews are only slightly similar to the exams but they do help a little. Her quizzes are dreadful and extremely difficult. To do good in her class you have to spam homework practices and study hard.

reviews.comment: Lectures suck you have to learn everything on your own.

There is no question that Dr. Altman has extended knowledge in chemistry. However, lectures were somewhat unengaging and fast paced. In fact, when Dr. Altermose would sub the entire environment seemed better and her lectures were engaging. Overall, with a little outside studying and attending some SI sessions, a good grade isn't out of reach.

Altman had very poor lectures, she was not able to confidently take control of the room, her voice was quiet, but she was also condescending when questions were asked. The homework always had material she never covered, the quizzes were much more difficult than the homework. You are better off finding online material from another prof, or your TA.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Taking notes on paper is difficult, her lectures are often overwhelming and difficult to understand. She seems like a very talented and passionate chemist, but her teaching is not reflective of that. Class and office hours were often frustrating, but with lots of work you can pass.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. She does not care about you learning the material. She does not answer questions. She would rather do anything but actually teach chemistry. She seems to have a power trip and enjoys us not doing good. If you ask her a question she will hit you with either "See me in office hours" or "Just review the material yourself". 0 / 10

Dr Altman's class is a waste of time. She doesn't actually teach the material, instead it is more like she is just telling it to you and expecting you to immediately comprehend it. If you ask questions you are either answered in a very condescending way or told to go office hours . Quizzes are awful and mock exams are nothing like the real ones.
Terrible

It's very apparent that she is employed by the university to conduct research, not for her teaching abilities. She acted disinterested in answering any questions I had and like she had something better to do. If you have to take this class, don't take her. She treats teaching as a check in the box. If I could rate her at a negative value I would.

Rushes through lectures and as someone who takes notes on paper, very difficult to follow and retain information. When students asked questions in class she would tell them to go to office hours even if it could be answered in a short response. Over complicated subjects and SI was more helpful.

Dr. Altman is very knowledgeable in chemistry. However, she is not good at teaching this knowledge to her students. Her lectures are confusing and topics are not explained clearly. She rushes through lectures and does not prioritize understanding. Dr. Altimose subbed for my section a few times and she was a much better lecturer.

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. Her lectures were difficult to understand because she teaches like we have been taking chemistry for 4 years, and assumes we understand. The weekly quizzes are very difficult and practice exams are nothing like the real ones. The only positive is her grading system helps out significantly with her poor exam scores.

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've had the misfortune of stumbling upon. She RUSHES and doesn't explain topics well, and she's almost never available because her office hours are very limited and directly after class. Altemose, the other chem professor, occasionally subbed and she is 100x better. Try and get into her class! DO NOT waste your time with Altman.

Altman was out Prof. Altemose subbed in and she was so much better, I wish I took her class.

Worst professor I have ever had.

reviews.comment: Not a good teacher at all, horrible lectures to follow, doesn't get the class involved. Does iclicker and exams are nothing like mock exams. Homework every Tuesday and hides canvas grades.

She spends more time talking about how cool the topics she's teaching are than actually explain them. Lectures are pretty unhelpful and you're not able to see your average grade in Canvas. SI sessions and YouTube are only way o learned anything from this class, just go with a different prof for this course.

Dr. Altman is hard to understand, and not a great communicator of ideas. I will say, the syllabus and grade requirements aren't bad, but to learn the content in her class you're better off watching youtube and reading the textbook. Which is unfortunate since 15% of the class grade is from iClickers.
